description: This file defines a singleton class AgentEventStore that manages a collection of ControlAgentEvent objects, providing methods to append new events and clear the event list.

classes.name: AgentEventStore
classes.description: A singleton class that stores and manages ControlAgentEvent instances, supporting appending and clearing operations.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new ControlAgentEvent to the store and maintains the maximum size of the event list.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all events from the store.
